name: Chosen Context
vision_statement: The planner reads the material the request concerns, however the request is worded.
opportunities: Which material a planner reads is a retrieval problem with its own alternatives and its own public evidence, which the parent solution does not weigh: lexical, vector and hybrid rankers over a person's cards, files and conversations, a ranker per representative, references that must resolve to current text without failing a turn, and one ranking that holds the cards and the specification records of a repository together so a run also sees when no solution covers its request. Public benchmarks of similar rankers are shown beside the measurements made here.
solution_coherence: Context Retriever picks the cards, files and conversations that bear on a request, however it is worded, by ranking them and keeping what is confident enough.
